evidence.title: EQS ad-hoc, 7 Sep 2026 11:51 CEST: paragon and two further group companies file for insolvency
evidence.excerpt: paragon GmbH & Co. KGaA, paragon electronic GmbH and paragon movasys GmbH filed at the Amtsgericht Paderborn. Regular proceedings; no self-administration is applied for. Reason: 'Ein Investor trotz Nachfristsetzung seinen vertraglichen Pflichten zur Auszahlung von Darlehen in zweistelliger Millionenhöhe nicht nachgekommen ist.' Management expects 'die Geschäftstätigkeit ... fortgeführt wird' after a provisional administrator is appointed.

evidence.title: Amtsgericht Paderborn orders, 7 Sep 2026: provisional administration for all three companies (97 IN 318/26, 319/26, 320/26)
evidence.excerpt: Orders at 13:51, 14:25 and 14:38 on 7 September: vorläufige Insolvenzverwaltung for paragon electronic GmbH (97 IN 318/26), paragon movasys GmbH (97 IN 319/26) and paragon GmbH & Co. KGaA (97 IN 320/26); Martin Mucha, Stuttgart, appointed provisional administrator in all three; the companies may dispose of assets only with his consent. No Eigenverwaltung and no Schutzschirm: the court took the regular route on the day of filing.

evidence.title: EQS corporate news, 7 Sep 2026: the company's own account (Tejascore, 552 staff, six sites, sole-supplier share)
evidence.excerpt: Tejascore Techsystems Inc. signed a binding term sheet on 19 June 2026 for minority stakes and a financing confirmation for a EUR 12m loan, then did not pay. 552 employees at Delbrück, Suhl, Landsberg am Lech, Limbach, Nuremberg and St. Georgen; Croatia and China not filed. 'paragon is the sole supplier, accounting for approximately 94% of revenue' to major automakers, none named; 'substantial' order backlog; profitable in the 2025 preliminaries; debt reduced by more than 64%.

evidence.title: BondGuide, 7 Sep 2026: 'Schon wieder fehlen Millionen, erneut Insolvenz'
evidence.excerpt: The notes, issued 2017 with an original 2022 maturity, were extended again to 2031. EUR 5m of the Tejascore money was due in June and EUR 7m in July 2026; management alleges fraudulent misrepresentation (claimed US funds above USD 100m). The 12m would have funded the company 'until end of 2028'. Second official insolvency of the parent (2009, self-administered plan). The editor is sceptical: persistent net losses behind EBITDA headlines. No price quotes in the piece.

evidence.title: Anleihen-Finder, 7 Sep 2026: the notes DE000A2GSB86, EUR 43.65m outstanding, extended to 5 July 2031 at the end of 2025
evidence.excerpt: ISIN DE000A2GSB86; a four-year extension finalised at the end of 2025 moved the maturity to 5 July 2031; EUR 43.65m outstanding. 552 employees at six German sites; Croatia and China continue. Frers: 'Ich bin extrem enttäuscht von dem potenziellen Partner.' Management expects continued operations after the administrator's appointment. No bond quotes in the piece. The instrument the operator called '2017/2027' is the same notes after two prolongations.

evidence.title: ad-hoc-news / regional press, 8 Sep 2026: 552 jobs at risk, Suhl over 250; production to continue without interruption
evidence.excerpt: Over 250 of the 552 employees are in Suhl (Thuringia). Production is intended to continue without interruption; management 'betonte, dass das Unternehmen grundsätzlich profitabel arbeite'. Employee representatives face the wage-security question; Insolvenzgeld is not yet addressed in print. Customers not named. The 2009 insolvency, exited in 2010, is recalled.

evidence.title: paragon (XETRA:PGN) daily closes, 1-8 Sep 2026
evidence.excerpt: PGN: 1 Sep 1.58; 2 Sep 1.54; 3 Sep 1.47; 4 Sep 1.48 (+0.34%); 7 Sep 0.70 (-52.81%); 8 Sep 0.678 (0.00%). The 8 September close is 54% below the 4 September close. Tradegate (ariva): 4 Sep 1.395; 7 Sep 0.654; 8 Sep 0.638 (-2.45%). The ad-hoc landed at 11:51 on the 7th, inside the session.

evidence.title: ariva, 8 Sep 2026 10:08: paragon notes DE000A2GSB86 bid 5.00 / ask 5.45 (Frankfurt), -23.08% on the day
evidence.excerpt: Frankfurt quote at 10:08 on 8 September: bid 5.00, ask 5.45, change -23.08% on the day, which puts the prior print near 6.5. A search summary of finanzen.net (undated, before the filing) had the notes around 18% of par at a yield near 70%. The ariva master data still shows the original 4.5% 2017/2022 terms; the instrument was prolonged twice. No dated 4 September quote was reachable: comdirect 401, finanzen.net 403 to the fetcher.

evidence.title: Volkswagen (VOW3), BMW, Continental (CON) closes 4-8 Sep 2026, DAX ETF (EXS1) for the market; 8 Sep prints intraday
Voltabox (now trading as Voltatron, XETRA) closes 1-8 Sep 2026
evidence.excerpt: Xetra: 1 Sep 4.00; 2 Sep 3.945; 3 Sep 3.955; 4 Sep 3.955; 7 Sep 3.93 (-0.025); 8 Sep 3.93 (unchanged). No move on the filing day in the former subsidiary; the company now trades under the Voltatron name.

evidence.title: Coverage record, 8 Sep 2026: what the fetcher could and could not read on day one
evidence.excerpt: Read: the EQS ad-hoc and corporate releases, the court orders with case numbers, BondGuide, Anleihen-Finder, ad-hoc-news regional coverage, XETRA closes, an intraday bond quote. Not read: finanzen.net (403), comdirect (401), insolvenzbekanntmachungen.de (TLS failure), Automobilwoche (paywall), the OEMs' IR calendars (no Wayback snapshot). No OEM has commented; no Insolvenzgeld statement yet; no administrator statement beyond the appointment.

resolutions.scorer_note: Early: the form of proceedings is stated in the ad-hoc and in the court orders of the same day. No Eigenverwaltung: regular proceedings with Martin Mucha as provisional administrator in all three cases. The 2009 precedent did not repeat; the baseline (regular proceedings for a second filing) had it.

Early: closes are final. PGN 1.48 on 4 September, 0.70 on the 7th (-52.8%, ad-hoc at 11:51), 0.678 on the 8th: 54% below the 4 September close, over the 30% line. No mechanism cited (a stated event, not a lag); the baseline said the shares fall too.
